data.name: Zebediah
data.gender_notes: Zebediah is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Zebediah is derived from the Hebrew words ‘zeb’ meaning ‘to divide’ and ‘deh’ meaning ‘multitude’. This name signifies ‘God is my multitude’ or ‘God is my abundance’. In the Bible, Zebediah is the name of several prophets and priests, emphasizing the connection between divine guidance and abundance. The name Zebediah carries the meaning “God is my multitude” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Zebediah usually hope their child will grow to embody god is my multitude and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zebediah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: זבדייה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זבדייה הוא שם פרטי עברי שמשמעותו 'מתנה אלוהים' או 'יבוא אלוהים'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'זבד' שפירושו מתנה ו'אל' שפירושו אלוהים. השם נמצא בתנ"ך מספר פעמים, ביניהן בספר עזרא ונחמיה, וגם היה שם של כהן שפעל בימי המלך יויקים.

in_greek.name: Ζεβεδιας
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζεβεδιας είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος זבדייה, που σημαίνει 'Θεοδωτος' ή 'Θεοπροϊσταμενος'. Το όνομα αυτό απαντάται και στη Καινή Διαθήκη, συγκεκριμένα στα Ευαγγέλια, ως το όνομα του πατέρα των αποστόλων Ιακώβου και Ιωάννη.

in_latin.name: Zebediah
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Zebediah origine hebraicum est, quod interpretatur 'Donum Dei' vel 'Deus advenit'. Nomen in Scripturis Sacris invenitur, praesertim in libris Ezrae et Nehemiae, etiam fuit nomen sacerdotis qui floruit temporibus regis Ioakim.

in_english.name: Zebediah
in_english.meaning: Gift of God, God has given
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zebediah originates from the Hebrew name זבדייה (Zebadiah), meaning 'gift of God' or 'God has given'. It is derived from the Hebrew words 'zabad,' meaning gift, and 'El,' referring to God. The name appears in the Bible, particularly in the books of Ezra and Nehemiah, and also refers to the father of the apostles James and John in the New Testament. Zebediah symbolizes divine providence and the preciousness of spiritual gifts.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zebediah was popularity in ancient Israel and amongst early Christians. Its Hebrew origin and biblical associations provide a cultural link to the rich history and heritage of the Jewish and Christian faiths.
data.spiritual_significance: Zebediah’s name carries a powerful spiritual message of God's abundance and presence in our lives. It serves as a reminder that God, being all-powerful, provides us with more than we could ever ask or imagine, and that His guidance and love is an ever-present reality.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Zebediah, meaning "exalted by God," symbolizes the deep faith and trust in God's divine intervention in one's life, inspiring humility and steadfastness in the face of challenges.

biblical_reference.note: Referenced as Zebedee, father of James and John

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Biblical: Old Testament, Book of Jeremiah, 1:1 The name Zebediah carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Christian name websites where expectant parents research meaningful Biblical names. The name bridges traditional Christian values with modern faith identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and Biblical significance.
